business_summary: MORESCO Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells chemical products in Japan, China, Southeast/South Asia, and North America. The company offers die casting lubricants, including water-soluble minimum quantity spray type lubricant, water-soluble diluted type, powder release agent, as well as for zinc, magnesium, and squeeze and low speed processes; water soluble cutting fluids; and hot melt adhesives. It also provides radiation resistant lubricating oil and greases; and sodium, calcium, barium, synthetic sulfonates, as well as packaged rust-preventative, packaged emulsified oil, and packaged soluble oil additive; gas and water vapor transmittance measurement device; plunger lubricants; high vacuum pump oil; synthetic lubricating oils; and hard disk surface lubricant. In addition, the company offers heat transfer medium; flexible organic photovoltaics; lubricant for hot forging; fire-resistant hydraulic fluid and other products; high temperature lubricating oils and greases, such as L/LM/RX series, LE series, MO series, LS-E/R series, BS series, and High temperature greases; liquid paraffin, purified liquid paraffin, and lubricants and grease for food machinery; organic device sealant; and wastewater treatment agents and equipment comprising emulsion breaker wastewater treatment agents, coagulant treatment equipment, and UF membrane wastewater treatment equipment. Its products are used in automobiles, iron and steel, construction materials, fibers, food, packaging materials, nuclear power related, plastic, sanitary and daily goods, cosmetics/pharmaceuticals, factory and equipment related, electronic equipment and home electric appliances, aircraft, industrial machinery, wastewater treatment, and other applications. The company was formerly known as Matsumura Oil Reserch Corp. and changed its name to MORESCO Corporation in 2009. MORESCO Corporation was incorporated in 1958 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.
